\section{PPI++ Empirical Validation on LLM-Derived Confusion Matrices}
\label{app:ppi-empirical}

We validate PPI++ (and four comparison correction methods) on the 2 zero-matrix-filtered empirical confusion matrices from plan~006, spanning K\!\in\!\{2,3,10\} across 2 DAG topologies. Each (config, topology) is evaluated over $N_{\\text{sim}}=5$ Monte-Carlo replications with $N=5000$ synthetic units and $N_{\\text{gold}}=500$ gold-standard labels. Bias reduction is reported as $1 - |\\text{bias}_{\\text{corr}}| / |\\text{bias}_{\\text{uncorr}}|$ (larger is better; 100\% = perfect).

\paragraph{Methodological notes.}
(i) For $K\!=\!10$ humaid configs the empirical $C$ matrices are loaded directly from \texttt{plan006/asv\_empirical\_results.json}. For $K\!=\!2$ civil\_comments and $K\!=\!3$ vast, $C$ is reconstructed from per-class recall (diagonal): the $K\!=\!2$ reconstruction is exact (off-diagonals fully determined by $1-\mathrm{diag}$), while $K\!=\!3$ uses a uniform off-diagonal split. (ii) The target estimand is the OLS coefficient on $T$ (treatment topologies) or on the first dummy of $A$ (no-treatment topologies). For the IV topology this differs from the IV-Wald estimand reported in the bias analysis (\Cref{sec:bias}); MC results here measure how well each method recovers the OLS oracle, which itself is biased relative to the structural IV target. (iii) PPI++ uses bootstrap $\\lambda$ tuning (50 draws) over the gold subset; DSL initialises $C$ from gold and runs joint EM (max 100 iterations); MC-SIMEX uses $\\lambda\\in\\{0.5,1.0,1.5,2.0\\}$ with $B=50$ inner draws.
